findingClass: the conflict writer records rows no source disagreement produced: a writer-stamped bookkeeping field (lastScrapedAt, updatedAt, ...) or a value with binary-float residue (428400000.00000006), #818 / F-181
failThreshold: any data_conflicts row with detected_at in the last 48h whose field_name is in WRITER_BOOKKEEPING_FIELDS, or whose field_name is in RUPEE_AMOUNT_FIELDS (NUMERIC(...,2) money columns, scripts/lib/conflict-reasons.mjs) and whose value1/value2 is a plain number with more than two decimals; ratios and percentages are never judged for decimals; identities (slug, field, both sides) printed
